method: Compared the BMB 2019 “Lake Mojicap” row (San Pablo City) with LLDA’s 2015 annual-report table headed “7 Lakes of San Pablo”, which lists “Mojicap Lake”, and LLDA’s current Seven Crater Lakes page, which lists “Mohicap Lake” in its seven-lake roster. Their matching seven-lake set supports a working spelling-alias crosswalk to the existing Mohicap lead; preserve the source spelling and do not claim an official name-change ruling. Link the printed city locality to the PSA City of San Pablo code. No reported fingerling quantity is reused as species evidence.
